$comment: User-scope MCP servers, registered by scripts/install-mcp.ps1 during setup. Project-scope servers live in mcp/catalog.json and are added with `tazuna mcp add <name>`. Secrets must be written as ${ENV_VAR} placeholders, never literals.

context7.$why: Version-accurate library documentation. Two read-only tools. See docs/mcp.md for the five answers this required. Works without an API key; for higher rate limits get one at context7.com/dashboard and add "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}" } here - the placeholder, never the value.

playwright.$why: The browser as a sensor: open the app, click, fill forms, look at the result after a UI change. 25 tools in every session, all answered with ask by the permission model. --isolated keeps the browser profile in memory so a session does not accumulate cookies.

agent-skills.$why: Search and load any skill of the Tech Leads Club catalog on demand, without installing it: four read tools, progressive disclosure.
